skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cleaning] — You wipe down the nearest surface out of old habit. It gleams.
skills.description: Cleans mundane messes with supernatural ease.
Steadier hands with any blade.
A frame hardened by work and worse.
Everything behind one blow.
The next blade that finds you meets an answer.
A felled foe quickens the blood.
A hissing dart of goblin fire.
A roaring lance of goblin-fire down the line.
A dart of biting cold that clings to the legs.
Woven mana drinks the blow before flesh does.
The first spell leaves the fingers before the thought finishes.

skills.field_ambient: [Light] — A steady white orb rises to follow you, throwing back the dark.
skills.description: A mage's first, faithful spell: a small orb of steady white light.
The feet decide before the mind does.
Breath returns, and the body remembers it can go on.
A cold prickle at the neck, a heartbeat before harm.
Thrusts that seek the seams in any guard.
A cut loosed before the guard can rise.
One bright line. The eye catches up too late.
Mid-swing, the blade bends its path toward whatever is unguarded.
Three points of pain in a single breath.
A wide, raking arc that finds an opening no straight thrust could.
For one moment the air is stitched with spearpoints.
A fist-sized spike of ice, hurled hard enough to crack shields.

skills._comment: Canon pass: renamed [Icy Floor] -> [Ice Floor] (id `icy_floor` UNCHANGED -- save-compat). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Ceria Springwalker's spell list names [Ice Floor] directly. WIRED for real -- WISkillEffects.resolve_active gained an icy_floor resolver (area terrain state on WICombat.terrain, keyed by cell; applies `effect.applies` to every living occupant of the blast regardless of side, both on cast and on standing on/stepping onto an icy cell; purges at round rollover). effect_text.gd generates the real card line from `range`/`radius`/`duration_rounds` instead of suppressing it. See wi_combat.gd/skill_effects.gd doc comments for the mechanism.
skills.description: The stones glaze over, and footing becomes a rumor.
An arm's-length arc of fire, reaped close.
A snap of light and heat that leaves spots dancing in the eyes.
Mana runs down the blade until the edge sings.
Chores that would tire another barely slow you.

skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cooking] — You picture the dish this place is missing. Your hands twitch toward a ladle that isn't there.
skills.description: Simple meals come out right, every time.
Trays, kegs, and crates feel lighter than they should.

skills._comment: Canon pass: renamed [Observe] -> [Appraise Foe] (id `observe` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Skills Effect/A -- 'Provides limited information about another person', near-verbatim our mechanic. [Owl's Vision] was checked and REJECTED (attested -- Ridine's [Owl's Vision: Location] -- but its canon function is enhanced/night VISION, not a person-read; renaming to it would misuse an attested Skill). NOTE the quirk this Skill also reads friendly NPCs/props, not just foes -- off-label Skill use is in-register for TWI, and the Tactician-kit framing fits.
skills.field_ambient: [Appraise Foe] — You take in the empty space around you. Nothing here rewards a closer look.
skills.description: A measuring look that reads a room, a person, a problem, and files it away for later.
The whole field resolves into a map. You always know the one step that matters.

skills.field_ambient: [Soothe Clientele] — You offer the empty room a calming word. Only the dust settles.
skills.description: A word and a refilled glass, and the room's troubles ease. Patrons forget whatever was gnawing at them.

skills.field_ambient: [Unerring Aim] — You size up a throw out of habit. Nothing here is worth the toss.
skills.description: Whatever you throw finds its mark: a mug slid down the bar, a rag, or a troublemaker's head.

skills.field_ambient: [Sweep the Tables] — You reach to clear the dishes. The tables here are already bare.
skills.description: A cluttered table comes clean in a single pass, the dishes spirited back to the kitchen.

skills.field_ambient: [Server's Prescience] — You listen for what the room needs next. All quiet, for now.
skills.description: You know what a guest wants before they raise a hand: the empty cup, the missing fork, the order about to be called.

skills.field_ambient: [Charming Smile] — You flash a warm, easy smile at no one in particular. A passing sparrow seems charmed, at least.
skills.description: A warm, disarming smile that puts people at ease and turns a cold first meeting friendly.
A steadying word and a calming hand; the fight drains out of a foe, and their guard turns slow and uncertain.

skills._comment: The Awakened Raskghar's signature (enemy-only; no class grants it). A REACHING heavy swing realized on the EXISTING frost_bolt/[Calming Touch] applies-rider machinery -- spell_damage + the same `slowed` pool_penalty rider, NO new effect type. range 2 (a hulking bear-lion's reach) is deliberate: it is the only value that lets the boss's `caster` AI actually FIRE the slow under the shipped combat_ai.gd -- a range-1 swing makes the ranged AI kite-then-never-cast, a range-2 swing makes it maintain reach and land the maul every turn (task-a2 report AI-fit analysis). die/ap_cost balance-tuned via sim_combat_batch.gd BOSS_CELLS to hold the 0.6-0.75 Relc band; slowed pool_penalty is the shared status (WICombat._start_turn expiry, identical to frost_bolt).
skills.description: A sweeping, reaching swipe of claw and forearm that batters the legs out from under you and leaves them slow to answer.

skills._comment: The frost field seam's caster skill. `freezes: true` is the ONLY tag the seam keys on (use_skill_field): faced at a freezable water cell -> walkable ice until sleep. Exploration-only (no combat/mp_cost), so it is fight-determinism-neutral exactly like [Light]. Canon rename: [Frost Touch] -> [Snap Freeze] (id `frost_touch` UNCHANGED -- save-compat). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Ceria Springwalker + Az'kerash spell lists -- Ceria is our ice-mage adjacency exactly, and the utility-shaped freeze fits. `freeze_toast` overrides the seam's default cast line.
skills.freeze_toast: [Snap Freeze] — You lay your palm to the water and cold spiders out from it. In a breath the channel locks to grey-white ice, thick enough to bear your weight. It will not last past your next rest.
skills.field_ambient: [Snap Freeze] — Frost blooms from your fingers and hangs glittering in the air. There is nothing here for it to grip.
skills.description: A breath of deep cold that skins still water in load-bearing ice.

skills._comment: The burnable-prop field seam's caster skill. `burns: true` is the ONLY tag the seam keys on: faced at a prop tagged `burnable: true` -> the prop is removed permanently (removed_entities, saved) + a burn poof. Exploration-only, fight-determinism-neutral like frost_touch/[Light]. Canon rename: [Kindle] -> [Firefly] (id `kindle` UNCHANGED -- save-compat). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ATTESTED, Spells/F + ch. 8.43 -- '[Firefly] conjures a single mote of light that detonates'; a conjured fire mote fits igniting dry debris. No [Kindle]/[Ignite] Skill is attested ([Firestarter] is a CLASS -- Maviola El -- not a Skill, so it was rejected as a rename target).
skills.field_ambient: [Firefly] — A curl of flame dances up over your knuckles and gutters out. Nothing here will take the fire.
skills.description: A conjured flame, hot enough to take dry debris and old timber in moments.

skills._comment: The sneak seam, user-ratified stealth model. Canon rename (closes the provisional naming AND the real class grant): [Sneak] -> [Stealth] (id `sneak` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible, verified by grep -- no UI surface renders a raw id). CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- no bare stealth-walk Skill is attested, but the attested family [Stealth Arrow]/[Stealth Pause]/[Stealth Roll]/[Stealth Wing] (Skills Effect/S) establishes the [Stealth ...] grammar, and a bare noun passes the no-action-verb naming principle where '[Sneak]' (a plain verb) failed it. Now GRANTED by the earned [Rogue] class (gained_by `recovered_crate_watch`, POST-onboarding: that accomplishment is street-quest content, unreachable without already surviving the floodplains `goblin_encounter_1` ambush -- see classes.json's rogue `_comment` for the full trace). `sneaks: true` is the ONLY tag the field-hotbar toggle keys on (use_skill_field's `_toggle_sneak`), NOT this skill id -- pressing its number key flips `sneaking` on/off; `field_ambient`/`freezes`/`burns`/etc. are irrelevant to it (the toggle branch returns before any of those checks run). Combat read: `ap_cost: 1` + `effect: {type: move_pool_bonus, amount: 2}` -- a genuine self-targeted move-pool grant, ACTIVELY wired through WISkillEffects.resolve_active (see that file's doc comment for the ap_cost>0 gate that deliberately leaves the two PRE-EXISTING 0-cost move_pool_bonus skills, quick_movement/battlefield_awareness, exactly as unresolved/refused as before). Unlike frost_touch/kindle this IS combat-context, so it is only fight-determinism-neutral for scripts that never press it in a fight -- true of every canonical script today (stealth_loop and rogue_earn_loop both end before any combat begins).
skills.description: A soft step that slips past watching eyes and clears ground when blades are drawn.

skills._comment: Issue #22, the Mage's own second stealth verb -- USER RULING 4: stealth's HOME is [Rogue] ([Stealth] above), but a Mage may separately gain [Invisibility] as a spell. CANON-VERDICT (docs/design/k3-canon-verdicts.md): ATTESTED Tier-4 spell (Montressa du Valeross, Salamani, Ecleeif; [Greater Invisibility] also attested). SEAM INVESTIGATION (the issue's core question): does this need new sim machinery, or does it reuse [Stealth]'s seam? It reuses it COMPLETELY -- field_skills.gd's `use_skill_field` dispatch keys the sneak toggle on the `sneaks: true` DATA TAG, never on a skill id (see `sneak`'s own comment + test_sim_core.gd's synthetic `stealth_ritual` tag-vs-id proof), so tagging THIS skill `sneaks: true` wires it into the exact same `WIGame.sneaking` flag/`_toggle_sneak`/`_break_sneak`/`_check_trigger_radius` skip with ZERO sim edits. FIELD-ONLY this issue (`contexts: ["exploration"]`, no `ap_cost`/`effect`): the COMBAT read (excluding this PC from enemy AI targeting) is DEFERRED per the ruling's "queue, don't force" clause -- that is new sim ground (AI-targeting exclusion has no existing seam to reuse, unlike the exploration skip), so it is queued as its own follow-up rather than half-shipped here. Consequence, working as intended: `WIEffectText.skill_effect_lines` reads only `effect`/`ap_cost`, sees neither, and returns [] -- the honest no-combat-effect card (see test_effect_text.gd's EXPECTED_SKILLS pin), same as frost_touch/kindle. The description below is worded to promise ONLY the real exploration effect, never a combat one. VISUAL: `sneak_visual` is a NEW but presentation-only data key (read by world.gd's `_reconcile_sneak_visual`, never by any sim file) giving this skill a DISTINCT look from [Stealth]'s plain translucency -- deeper alpha (0.35 vs [Stealth]'s default 0.6 `SNEAK_ALPHA`) plus the shimmer treatment (a ShaderMaterial reusing the EXISTING water_shimmer.gdshader's uv-wobble, the same shader the floodplains pond overlay already uses -- reused wholesale, not a new shader file, so this is a DATA-driven variation of the existing sneak-visual hook, not new presentation machinery either). COEXISTENCE (ruling's point on two verbs at once): [Stealth] and [Invisibility] both flip the SAME single `sneaking` bool -- there is only ever one stance, so pressing one while the other is "active" just re-toggles that one shared flag off (whichever skill is pressed second wins, honestly, not a stacked/nested state) -- `mage_invisibility_loop`'s canonical proves this live: [Invisibility] toggles sneaking ON with its own distinct render, then [Stealth] toggles the SAME flag OFF.
skills.description: A working that bends the light around you until even a careful eye finds nothing worth watching.
